youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

She is still job hunting. Four aunties asked what she earns before the sweets were served.

She: Jesus... every aunty at Diwali asked what I earn. What do I even say? 😔
She: Forty applications this month. Nothing came back. My cousin cleared his interview in one try.
Jesus: They counted your salary twice. Nobody asked what you survived this year.
She: But You say You’ll provide. It’s November and nothing came.
Jesus: Provision isn’t late because the table is loud. Your worth wasn’t on that menu.
Jesus: Seek Him first. The rest follows, even when it walks slower than your cousin.

“But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.”
Matthew 6:33 (BSB)
